control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: potential incident - thermal exposure at G-8103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on G-8103 and TT-8103 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. G-8103 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during routine operation while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 21 February 2016 a potential incident was recorded on G-8103 and TT-8103 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during routine operation; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
